verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a security and compliance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents a way for users to define their own event-to-action rules. The closest items are adjacent features: fixed daily code scans, controls the system adds automatically per framework, Fieldwork AI agents that collect evidence on a schedule, and MDM device policies. None of these is a user-defined trigger that fires an action when an event occurs.
